newest.RootCause:
Changing language changes the CMS ETag, so the whole I2V style folder is deleted and the sample images are re-downloaded one by one in background.
The sample image was only read from the local file when a style is selected, so it fell back to the default image (or read a partially written file), and the UI was never refreshed after the download finished.
newest.Solution:
1. ImageToVideoTemplatesTabFragment: when the local sample image is missing, show the default image first and load sourceImageURL via Glide,
cancel the pending request when switching style or destroying the view.
 2. ImageToVideoActivityViewModel: download to a .tmp file and rename it only after the MD5 check passes, so readers never see a partially written file.
newest.Function: only affect image to video room

newest.RootCause: onGoArtwork hardcoded ARTWORK_AI_EDIT_CHAT_IMAGE for both the auto-scroll target and the preference Artwork reloads on resume, so the page always landed on the photo tab whatever the room had produced.
newest.Solution: GoToArtworkPage now carries the tab to open and the navigator uses it for both, still defaulting to the photo tab. The view model picks it from the newest finished result of the room on screen: a video result opens the video tab, anything else, or a room with no result yet, opens the photo tab. Results still running are skipped since they have no file to tell image from video yet.

newest.RootCause: Reuse passed the saved prompt to the Image to Video screen. A non-empty prompt made shouldShowMainPageDirectly() return true, so the app opened the Custom page directly and never checked the explanation sheet.
newest.Solution: A Custom Reuse (one with reuse settings) no longer takes that shortcut. It goes through the normal intro check, which respects "Don't show again" and deep links. After "Try now" it opens Custom with the reused model and prompt, which the view model already holds. Prompt-only reuse and restored state still open the main page directly
